nonGoals: Exact combat rounds are not modeled.

Raw verified ability wording is preserved for player reference but does not drive a combat simulator.

Add an audit disposition for each ability.

Visually confirm the Dragon Database and Formation Builder.

abilities.name: Blazing Fury

Progression: Habit Level 1: -3.5%; Habit Level 2: -4.2%; Habit Level 3: -4.9%; Habit Level 4: -5.95%; Habit Level 5: -7%.

abilities.name: Cloak of Terror
abilities.rawDescription:
Odd-numbered Rounds: 10% chance to afflict Overwhelm on 2 Enemies within adjacency for 2 round(s). This chance is doubled (20%) if the target is afflicted with Vulnerable.

Overwhelm prevents the target from using Active Commands and Habits on their turn.

Progression: Habit Level 1: Overwhelm chance 10%; Habit Level 2: 13%; Habit Level 3: 16%; Habit Level 4: 20%; Habit Level 5: 25%.

abilities.name: Cobalt Flame
abilities.rawDescription:
Rounds 1, 4, 7: Deal Fire Damage to 1 Enemy in any lane, prioritizes targets that deals Physical Damage, excluding Basic Attacks, Damage Rate: +95%. Additionally, 50% chance to reduce the target's Damage Dealt by -10% for 2 round(s). Double this effect (-20%) if the target deals Physical Damage, excluding Basic Attacks.

Rounds 3, 6, 9: Deal Physical Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane, Damage Rate: +60%.

Fire Damage:
Deal Fire Damage to the target. Fire Damage is increased by the attacker's Intelligence and mitigated by the target's Initiative.

Damage Dealt Modifier:
Modify the target's Damage Dealt by -10%.

Physical Damage:
Deal Physical Damage to the target. Physical Damage is increased by the attacker's Strength and mitigated by the target's Instinct.

abilities.name: Champion's Brilliance
abilities.rawDescription: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard, Increase your Strength, Intelligence, and Instinct by +15. Reduce Damage Received by -8% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

abilities.name: Sharpened Beauty
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Each Round: Increase your Physical and Fire Damage Dealt by +8.4% until the end of the round. Double these effects (+16.8%) if you are above 75% Troop Capacity or if you have Advantage.

Progression table:
Habit Level 1: Physical and Fire Damage Dealt +7%
Habit Level 2: +8.4%
Habit Level 3: +9.8%
Habit Level 4: +11.9%
Habit Level 5: +14%

abilities.name: Blazing Leader
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Combat: Increase the Fire Damage Dealt by +10% of 1 Ally in any lane, prioritizes the Left Flank, until the end of combat.

Progression table:
Habit Level 1: Fire Damage Dealt +10%
Habit Level 2: +12%
Habit Level 3: +14%
Habit Level 4: +17%
Habit Level 5: +20%

abilities.name: Molten Armor
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Odd-numbered Rounds: 25% chance to increase your Fire Damage Dealt by +12% and reduce Physical Damage Received by -12% of 2 other Allies in any lane. If you are afflicted with Panic, also apply the reduced Physical Damage Received effect to yourself. Each effect lasts for 2 round(s).

Progression table:
Habit Level 1: Molten Armor Chance 25%
Habit Level 2: 30%
Habit Level 3: 35%
Habit Level 4: 42.5%
Habit Level 5: 50%

abilities.name: Clever Maneuver
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Combat: Increase Intelligence by +18% and Initiative by +9% of the Ally with the highest Intelligence until the end of combat. Both effects are enhanced by Instinct.

Progression table:
Habit Level 1: Intelligence +18%; Initiative +9%
Habit Level 2: Intelligence +21.6%; Initiative +10.8%
Habit Level 3: Intelligence +25.2%; Initiative +12.6%
Habit Level 4: Intelligence +30.6%; Initiative +15.3%
Habit Level 5: Intelligence +36%; Initiative +18%

abilities.name: The Blue Queen
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Odd-numbered Rounds: 40% chance to reduce the Damage Received by -10% and increase the Intelligence, enhanced by Intelligence, by +15% of 1 other Ally in any lane that deals Fire Damage for 2 round(s). If you are above 75% Troop Capacity, double the Damage Received reduction (-20%) and Intelligence increase (+30%).

Progression table:
Habit Level 1: The Blue Queen Chance 40%
Habit Level 2: 52%
Habit Level 3: 64%
Habit Level 4: 80%
Habit Level 5: 100%

abilities.name: Wild Hunt
abilities.rawDescription:
Each Round: if no enemy is currently marked as Prey, 40% chance to apply Prey. Rounds 1, 4, 7, and 10: deal Fire Damage to one enemy, prioritizing Prey. Damage is doubled against Prey.

At 10 Stars:

Each round while Sheepstealer has a current Prey: deal Fire Damage to Prey at a 24% rate and apply Recovery to Sheepstealer at a 10% rate, enhanced by Dragon Level and Intelligence.

If the current Prey received Recovery during the previous round, both rates are tripled to 72% Fire Damage and 30% Recovery.

Star Rank 10 augmentation:
At 10 Stars, Savage Claim augments Wild Hunt while Sheepstealer has a Prey.

abilities.name: Hunter's Cunning
abilities.rawDescription: At Level 16+ and deployed in Vanguard, increase self Recovery Received +20%, self Intelligence +25, and Right Flank ally Physical Damage Dealt +10%.

abilities.name: Stolen Flock
abilities.rawDescription: PvE Fire Damage bonus and Stolen Flock stacks from each round or when Prey receives Recovery.

abilities.name: Dragon's Cunning
abilities.rawDescription: Start of Combat: increase self Intelligence and reduce Instinct of two enemies within adjacency, enhanced by Initiative.

abilities.name: Baited Kill
abilities.rawDescription: Each Round: apply Vulnerable to Prey, doubled chance if Prey received Recovery last round; cleanse Sheepstealer if Prey is above 50% Troop Capacity.

abilities.name: Wary Beast
abilities.rawDescription: Start of Each Round: if Prey is above 50% Troop Capacity gain Evade. Start of Combat reduce Recovery Received of three enemies.

abilities.name: Savage Claim
abilities.rawDescription: Augments Wild Hunt: each round while Sheepstealer has Prey, deal Fire Damage to Prey and apply Recovery to Sheepstealer; triple both if Prey received Recovery previous round.

abilities.name: Spreading Blaze
abilities.rawDescription: After each Basic Attack: deal Physical Damage to one enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate +50%). Additionally, 20% chance to grant one Spreading Blaze stack to one ally that deals Tactical Damage. Repeat this chance once if any enemy deals Fire Damage.

abilities.name: Warrior's Zeal
abilities.rawDescription: At Level 16+ and deployed in Vanguard, increase Vermax Physical Damage Dealt by 16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative of Left Flank ally by +20.

abilities.name: Trial by Flame
abilities.rawDescription: Start of Each Round: reduce Fire Damage Received for allies below strict Troop Capacity thresholds until end of current round.

abilities.name: Reactive Instincts
abilities.rawDescription: Start of Combat: increase Instinct and Initiative of ally with highest Instinct, enhanced by Strength.

abilities.name: Rallying Flame
abilities.rawDescription: Start of Combat: gain Rallying Flame and grant Spreading Blaze, repeating once for each enemy that deals Fire Damage.

abilities.name: Dragon's Valor
abilities.rawDescription: Start of Combat: reduce self Damage Received and increase Strength until end of combat.

abilities.name: Unyielding Resolve
abilities.rawDescription: Start of Each Round: chance to grant Advantage +15% for two rounds. If afflicted with Weakend, chance is multiplied by 1.5 and successful activation removes Weakened.

statusGlossary.definition: Increases Damage Dealt. Magnitude may vary by ability.
Reduces Damage Received. Magnitude and duration are supplied by the source ability.
Target acts before all other combatants each round. Caraxes Infernal Burst separately verifies a First-Strike conditional damage multiplier.
Target attacks after all other combatants each round.
Deals Fire Damage each round. Verified Burn damage scales with attacker Intelligence and is mitigated by target Initiative.
Control is a status category that includes Stun, Stagger, Overwhelm, and Confusion.
Target gains a second Basic Attack each round.
Reduces Recovery Received per stack. Maximum three stacks. Exact per-stack value depends on Seasmoke Habit Level.
Deals periodic Tactical Damage each round. Kalspire verifies +20% Damage Rate and two-round duration for its Panic source.
Deals periodic Physical Damage each round. Kalspire verifies +20% Damage Rate and two-round duration for its Bleed source.
Prevents the target from activating Commands, activating Habits, and launching Basic Attacks on its turn.
Forces the target to launch its Basic Attack against the dragon that applied Taunt.
Control status that prevents Attack Modifier Commands and Basic Attacks on the target turn. It does not automatically block all Commands or Habits.
Control status: affected Command, Habit, and Basic Attack actions have a 50% chance to mistake allies and enemies.
Prevents Active Commands and Habits. It does not prevent Basic Attacks.
Stack status. Vhagar verifies a maximum of five stacks that last until end of combat, with per-stack Strength increase and Physical/Tactical Damage Received reduction.
Wild Hunt's mark reduces Recovery Received by 30% for three rounds.
Increases Damage Received.
Stack status used by Tashix. Each stack increases Tashix Fire Damage Dealt by 2.5%. Maximum 10 stacks.
Gives each incoming damage instance a chance to be ignored.
Increases Sheepstealer Fire Damage Dealt per stack. Maximum 10 stacks. Value depends on Habit Level.
Increases Vermax Physical Damage Dealt by 5% per stack. Maximum four stacks.
Increases Tactical Damage Dealt by 2.5% per stack. Maximum 10 stacks.
Reduces Damage Dealt. Crimson and Vhagar verify a 20% value for their Weakened sources.
A beneficial effect that may be removed by Cleanse Positive.
A harmful effect that may be removed by cleanse mechanics. Control effects can also be negative effects depending on the effect.
Removes one Positive effect from an enemy.
Restores troops to the target. Recovery may scale with Level or attributes by ability.

evidenceSummary.title: Warden's Rally Recovery included Malachite
evidenceSummary.description: Manual combat-log observation by the repository owner. Raw combat log has not yet been archived in the repository. Observation: Malachite appeared as a recipient of Warden's Rally Recovery, confirming that "3 Allies" includes the caster for this effect.

evidenceSummary.title: Warrior's Zeal affected Vermax Basic Attack Physical Damage
evidenceSummary.description: Manual combat-log observation by the repository owner. Observation: Warrior's Zeal increased Vermax's own Basic Attack Physical Damage, confirming that its unqualified Physical Damage Dealt modifier is not limited to Commands and Habits.

evidenceSummary.title: Wild Hunt prioritized an enemy that received Recovery last round
evidenceSummary.description: Manual combat-log observation by the repository owner. Observation: when selecting a new Prey, Sheepstealer prioritized an eligible enemy that received Recovery during the previous round. This applies only when no current Prey exists.

evidenceSummary.title: Ally and Other Ally targeting-language convention
evidenceSummary.description: Repeated manual ability-text review confirms that Other Ally and Other Allies exclude the caster, while plain Ally and Allies allow the caster to be selected when spatial targeting rules permit it.
